_comment: Mutation kill-rate thresholds, read by BOTH gate scripts: release/check_mutation_gate.py
(mutmut, over hooks/) and release/checkMutationGate.mts (Stryker, over builder/ + release/ +
metrics/). Single-sourced on purpose — two runtimes each hardcoding 90/95 is exactly how the
two gates drift apart, and a project that gates itself at >= 90% must not have two answers to
what 90 means. release/tests/mutationGate.spec.ts and release/tests/test_mutation_gate.py both
read this file, so a change here moves both gates or fails both suites.
